name: moe_gemm0_gemm1_fusion
description: Fuse MoE gate (X.G^T) and up (X.U^T) GEMMs into one TG, sharing a single X load to halve X HBM traffic
preconditions: gfx942 or gfx950 MoE fused MLP
gate and up projections have identical X operand and K depth
single TG per expert tile (32xsub_GU output)
FP8 weights with per-128 block scales
steps: Load X tile once into LDS during the GEMM0 phase (feed X + G from HBM in parallel)
Run GEMM0 accumulating into _v_Z, then dequant Z via (sX*sG) DPP broadcast
Run GEMM1 using X from LDS (not HBM) and U from HBM, accumulating into _v_GM1
Dequant GM1 via (sX*sU) DPP broadcast; fuse act(Z)*GM1 in fp32 registers before FP8 re-quant
Do not issue any HBM X loads inside GEMM1 -- that destroys the fusion win
expected_impact: halves X HBM traffic vs independent gate+up GEMMs; removes an entire kernel launch
